classification.difficultyReason: Select the appropriate taught conversion from each supplied representation to fill the other two labelled rows, simplifying fractions where needed.

inlines.text: Complete the table, using decimal, fraction and percentage equivalents for each value.

answer.worked:
Use place value to write decimals as fractions and simplify. Write percentages over $100$; multiply fractions or decimals by $100\%$ to obtain percentages.

$$\begin{align*}0.5&=\frac{5}{10}=\frac12=50\%\\\frac14&=\frac{25}{100}=0.25=25\%\\75\%&=\frac{75}{100}=\frac34=0.75\\0.4&=\frac4{10}=\frac25=40\%\\100\%&=\frac{100}{100}=1\\0.457&=\frac{457}{1000}=45.7\%\\\frac{23}{100}&=0.23=23\%\\0.403&=\frac{403}{1000}=40.3\%\\\frac58&=\frac{625}{1000}=0.625=62.5\%\end{align*}$$
